channel.title: O Thank Heaven 4 711 -- Maui Travel Blog
channel.description: Maui travel guides from an oceanfront condo on the west shore.

item.title: Maui vs the Big Island: Which Hawaii Island Is Right for You?
item.description: The two most popular neighbor islands have different strengths. The comparison that actually helps you decide.

item.title: Snorkeling in Maui with Kids: Best Spots and Tips
item.description: The best Maui snorkel spots for families with young children -- calm water, good visibility, and reef fish that kids actually want to see.

item.title: Best Food Trucks in Maui
item.description: From plate lunch to fresh fish tacos, Maui's food truck scene is one of the best ways to eat well without the resort price tag.

item.title: Ka'anapali Beach: A Complete Visitor Guide
item.description: Ka'anapali is one of the most recognized resort beaches in Hawaii. What to expect, where to park, and the best spots along its mile of sand.

item.title: Maui Helicopter Tours: What to Expect and Which to Book
item.description: A helicopter tour over Maui's sea cliffs, waterfalls, and Haleakala crater is one of the island's most dramatic experiences. Here is what to know before you book.
